descriptions.d25j_set_string_property_80175a34: Creates or updates the kind-4 string property named by the second argument: updates an existing slot under the flag rules (1 allow, 4 skip mode, 8 replace mode), otherwise allocates a 20-byte property, stores it with retain/release, sets value, name, mode and masked flags, decrements the free count and increments the global created counter; returns 0 or 0x80004005.
